# Digital Ins and Outs: *Ultrasonic Sensed Colors*

For the Blink project, I had the idea of recreating an [Etch A Sketch](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Etch_A_Sketch) using a tilt sensor, joystick, and external LED matrix. I was originally planning on making something similar, but only one RGB LED instead of a matrix. Unfortunately, the tilt sensor didn't work the way I intended, so I swapped to an ultrasonic distance sensor.

The final circuit does one of two things. First, when the user is within 60cm of the distance sensor (signaled when the white LED turns on) they can use the joystick to change the RGB LED's color. Up and down changes the strength of the current color while left and right swaps the current color (red, green, or blue). Second, when the user is outside the 60cm range, the RGB LED decreases at a constant rate until reaching zero. The joystick does nothing here.

## Code
``` arduino
// pins consts
const int PIN_LED_RGB_R = 11, PIN_LED_RGB_G = 10, PIN_LED_RGB_B = 9;
const int PIN_LED_WHITE = 12;
const int PIN_TRIG = 5, PIN_ECHO = 6;
const int PIN_STICK_X = A1, PIN_STICK_Y = A2, PIN_STICK_BTN = A3;

// other consts
const float MAX_DRAW_DIST = 60;
const int STICK_DEADZONE = 200;
const float COLOR_INC_PER_SEC = 128;

// output device states
int rgbValueR, rgbValueG, rgbValueB;
int whiteValue;

// input device states
float duration, distance;
int stickValueY, stickValueX;

// other states
int currColor;  // 0 = red, 1 = green, 2 = blue
bool canChangeColor;
unsigned long lastTimeStep;

void setup() {
  pinMode(PIN_LED_RGB_R, OUTPUT);
  pinMode(PIN_LED_RGB_G, OUTPUT);
  pinMode(PIN_LED_RGB_B, OUTPUT);
  pinMode(PIN_LED_WHITE, OUTPUT);

  pinMode(PIN_TRIG, OUTPUT);
  pinMode(PIN_ECHO, INPUT);

  pinMode(PIN_STICK_X, INPUT);
  pinMode(PIN_STICK_Y, INPUT);
  pinMode(PIN_STICK_BTN, INPUT_PULLUP);

  lastTimeStep = millis();
  rgbValueR = 0, rgbValueG = 0, rgbValueB = 0;
  whiteValue = LOW;
  currColor = 0;
  canChangeColor = true;
}

void loop() {
  // read inputs
  digitalWrite(PIN_TRIG, LOW);
  delayMicroseconds(2);
  digitalWrite(PIN_TRIG, HIGH);
  delayMicroseconds(10);
  digitalWrite(PIN_TRIG, LOW);
  duration = pulseIn(PIN_ECHO, HIGH);
  distance = (duration * .0343) / 2;

  stickValueY = map(analogRead(PIN_STICK_Y), 0, 1023, -512, 511);
  stickValueX = map(analogRead(PIN_STICK_X), 0, 1023, -512, 511);

  // update
  unsigned long timeStep = millis();
  float deltaTime = (timeStep - lastTimeStep) / 1000.0f;
  if (distance > MAX_DRAW_DIST) {
    outDistanceUpdate(deltaTime);
  } else {
    inDistanceUpdate(deltaTime);
  }

  // draw
  // the rgb led I used has a shared positive end, so values are reversed
  analogWrite(PIN_LED_RGB_R, abs(255 - rgbValueR));
  analogWrite(PIN_LED_RGB_G, abs(255 - rgbValueG));
  analogWrite(PIN_LED_RGB_B, abs(255 - rgbValueB));
  digitalWrite(PIN_LED_WHITE, whiteValue);

  lastTimeStep = timeStep;
  delay(10);
}

void outDistanceUpdate(float deltaTime) {
  whiteValue = LOW;

  float deltaColor = -COLOR_INC_PER_SEC * deltaTime;
  changeColor(0, deltaColor);
  changeColor(1, deltaColor);
  changeColor(2, deltaColor);
}

void inDistanceUpdate(float deltaTime) {
  whiteValue = HIGH;

  // right
  if (stickValueX > STICK_DEADZONE) {
    if (canChangeColor) {
      currColor = abs(currColor + 1) % 3;
      canChangeColor = false;
    }
  }
  // left
  else if (stickValueX < -STICK_DEADZONE) {
    if (canChangeColor) {
      currColor = abs(currColor + 2) % 3;
      canChangeColor = false;
    }
  }
  // down
  else if (stickValueY > STICK_DEADZONE) {
    changeColor(currColor, -COLOR_INC_PER_SEC * deltaTime * stickValueY / 512);
  }
  // up
  else if (stickValueY < -STICK_DEADZONE) {
    changeColor(currColor, -COLOR_INC_PER_SEC * deltaTime * stickValueY / 512);
  }
  // center
  else {
    if (!canChangeColor) {
      canChangeColor = true;
    }
  }
}

void changeColor(int color, float delta) {
  switch (color) {
    case 0:
      rgbValueR = constrain(rgbValueR + delta, 0, 255);
      break;
    case 1:
      rgbValueG = constrain(rgbValueG + delta, 0, 255);
      break;
    case 2:
      rgbValueB = constrain(rgbValueB + delta, 0, 255);
      break;
  }
}

```
